specifications.label: Affected section
specifications.quote: promet se je za šest dni na tej progi ustavil.

specifications.label: Fully rebuilt
specifications.value: ~11 km Borovnica-Verd (double track), ~9.5 km Verd-Logatec, ~6.5 km Postojna-Prestranek, stations Verd, Logatec, Postojna with portals, repairs ~26 km Logatec-Rakek-Postojna
specifications.quote: popolne obnove voznih mrež na odseku Borovnica–Verd (pribl. 11 km dvotirne proge) … na odseku Verd–Logatec (pribl. 9,5 km dvotirne proge) … na odseku Postojna–Prestranek (pribl. 6,5 km dvotirne proge)
specifications.quote_note: Checked word for word against the text of the file itself, read on 12 November 2026.

specifications.label: Mast type failed
specifications.value: concrete masts fell over ~1 km between Logatec and Verd
specifications.quote: Odstraniti je bilo treba tudi vse betonske drogove med Logatcem in Verdom.
specifications.quote_note: Checked word for word against the text of the file itself, read on 12 November 2026.

specifications.label: Restoration dates
specifications.value: diesel ~6-7 Feb 2014, last section (left track Borovnica-Verd) 31 Aug 2015, new Postojna portals 2016
specifications.quote: Dizelska vleka med Borovnico in Pivko je bila omogočena 7. februarja 2014. … Zadnji odsek je bil v obratovanje predan 31. 8. 2015, levi tir Borovnica–Verd
specifications.quote_note: Checked word for word against the text of the file itself, read on 12 November 2026.

specifications.label: Damage cost

specifications.label: Postojna railway station elevation
specifications.quote: At an elevation of 582 metres (1,909 ft), Postojna is the highest railway station in Slovenia.

source_differences: Nova proga: Postojna was the most devastated station, Pivka, Prestranek, Logatec and Verd also badly hit. Record note lists Postojna, Logatec, Verd and the Verd-Logatec, Borovnica-Verd sections but omits Postojna-Prestranek (6.5 km also fully rebuilt) and Pivka/Prestranek.
Nova proga does not mention ZAG, which masts ZAG analysed is unknown.
